from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib,json
from datetime import datetime,timezone
ROOT=Path('/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/juggle_history_longdiscount_baseline_1m_20261102')
REPO=Path('/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl')
WEIGHTS={'online': 'e82f4d84b0d8a5433d15d3532b110150c5d03c295f962a275bfc5748338f0bc4', 'target': '3954c0d07f508f5efd3b943bba9ed78fc5ec8180d4bb648074586d9eea72bea7'}
def save(status,**details):
    (ROOT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status=status,updated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),**details),indent=2)+chr(10))
try:
    for role in ['online','target']:
        bundle=ROOT/('frozen_'+role)
        assert hashlib.sha256((bundle/'model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==WEIGHTS[role]
        save('evaluating',role=role)
        cmd=[str(REPO/'.venv/bin/python'),'-u','-m','scripts.td3.juggle_survival','--run-dir',str(bundle),'--scenario-set','training','--episodes','32','--horizon','20000','--seed-base','700000','--gif-steps','200','--out-dir',str(ROOT/('paired_'+role+'_20k_eval'))]
        subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=REPO,check=True)
        assert hashlib.sha256((bundle/'model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==WEIGHTS[role]
        subprocess.run([cmd[0],'-m','scripts.analysis.juggle_motion_metrics','--results',str(ROOT/('paired_'+role+'_20k_eval')/'results.json')],cwd=REPO,check=True)
    save('complete')
except Exception as exc:
    save('failed',error=repr(exc))
    raise
